item.title: fix(ci): record startup JS growth in the Control UI budget baseline
item.summary: fix(ci): record startup JS growth in the Control UI budget baseline CI build-artifacts now measures 330521 B startup JS gzip, 14 B past baseline+tolerance (329483+1024) after today's Control UI fixes. Every PR building artifacts fails the budget check until the baseline records the measured bytes; max committed baseline (358400 B) still bounds growth.
